ITEM.PTXT: When the seat heater switch is turned ON, current flows from the thermostat to the seat cushion and seatback in a parallel circuit, warming the seat. The thermostat turns OFF when the seat warms up, cutting off current to the seat heater, and turns ON when the seat temperature drops, resuming current to the seat heater. This operation keeps the seat surface temperature at approximately 30°.
A temperature control device that automatically controls the heat source by means of a switch utilizing the expansion of a bimetal or mercury.
